retrievalProfile.description: A meta-photographic composition featuring a white studio backdrop set against a vast desert landscape with centered subjects and bold sans-serif typography.

recipe.visualDefinition: A wide-angle shot of three men standing in front of a white paper backdrop held by C-stands in a desert, framed by mountains and a blue sky, with yellow geometric text at the top and bottom.
coreVisualRelationships: Subjects centered within a white rectangular frame
Artificial studio elements contrasting with natural desert terrain
Symmetrical placement of typography at vertical extremes
Warm earth tones balanced by a vibrant cyan sky
coreInvariants: Visible photography equipment including C-stands and clamps
White rectangular backdrop as a secondary frame
Arid desert ground and mountain range background

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Three full-body figures centered horizontally, occupying the middle third of the vertical space.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bright white rectangular backdrop serves as the primary visual anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the top text, move down to the subjects, and finish at the bottom text, following the vertical central axis.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant negative space provided by the sky above and the desert floor below.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm tan and brown (desert floor and mountains)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the sky and text, with muted, naturalistic tones in the landscape.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface used for both header and footer for symmetry.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric circularity and sharp vertices.
Provides the necessary geometric uppercase presence.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a wide-angle photograph of a desert landscape with mountains under a blue sky. In the center, place a white photography backdrop held up by two metal C-stands. Three men in retro-inspired clothing stand in front of the backdrop.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add uppercase geometric sans-serif text in bright yellow at the top center and bottom center of the image with wide letter spacing.

verificationChecks: Are the C-stands visible at the edges of the backdrop?
Is the sky a vibrant cyan color?
Is the text a bold, geometric sans-serif?

mustAchieve: Balanced symmetry between top and bottom text

postGenerationChecks: Check that the backdrop looks like a physical object in the scene.
Ensure the yellow text is legible against the sky and ground.
Verify the C-stands are correctly rendered with legs and clamps.
Confirm the horizon line is straight.
recipe.reuseFormula: Place [Subject] in front of a [Backdrop Color] studio backdrop in a [Landscape Type] setting, framed by [Typography Style] in [Accent Color] at the top and bottom.
